name: openmarkdown
description: Local-first Markdown editor whose MCP server lets a coding agent and a human co-edit the same .md file — it opens and reveals files in the editor and reads or section-edits their contents. Tools: open_file, reveal, read_section, write_section, wait_for_change.
install:
# git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/OpenMarkdown-dev/OpenMarkdown-releases
# See source for mcpServers config block
